name: nexus_abstain_endorsement
description:
Withdraw or abstain from an endorsement for a mod [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].

Returns:
    JSON {message: ..., status: "Abstained"}.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

version.description: Mod version to abstain from endorsing.
version.title: Version
